purpose: Defines the default format of glossary files: placement, ID numbering, naming, the glossary line at the top of requirement and design documents, and the table structure of the glossary body.
summary: Glossary doc_type is glossary; requirement-side glossaries use the requirement ID scheme (GLS fallback), design-side ones use the design ID scheme
IDs are issued with the next-spec-id skill, never by hand
File name pattern {glossary ID}_{name}_glossary.md with snake_case English name
Document-top glossary line placed right after the title, separated by a comma for several IDs
Design documents list design-side glossary IDs followed by those of the input requirements document
Body table with four columns: term, definition, prerequisite terms, and disallowed paraphrases
Rules for each column: no brackets on terms, one term per row, define prerequisites in earlier rows, use none when empty
tasks: Writing the glossary line in a requirements or design document
Reviewing a glossary for format compliance
Defining terms for a feature or project
title: 用語集 デフォルトフォーマット
